audit_items.proof_trace: The Decimal type uses u256 internally (WAD = 1e18), and every arithmetic operation (add, mul, div) calls ensure_decimal_value_safe which asserts the result ≤ VALUE_MAX_256 = U64_MAX × WAD ≈ 1.845×10³⁷. Since VALUE_MAX_256 < U128_MAX (≈3.4×10³⁸), any computation that passes the guard is automatically within u128 bounds. Intermediate u256 products cannot overflow u256 because both operands are bounded by VALUE_MAX_256, yielding products ≤ (VALUE_MAX_256)² ≈ 3.4×10⁷⁴ << U256_MAX ≈ 1.16×10⁷⁷; extreme rate×dt values that would exceed VALUE_MAX_256 cause an explicit abort rather than silent overflow.
